patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are used for feature sections, combining large imagery with concise text blocks.
Headlines use an extremely large, bold, and blocky sans-serif font, often highlighted with a solid background color for emphasis.
A vibrant and high-contrast palette of bright yellow, energetic orange, and deep olive green creates a playful yet grounded brand identity.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth.
A massive, bold brand name ('HEYDAY') is revealed as a full-width background element at the very bottom of the page, acting as a strong visual anchor on scroll.
Product carousels are used repeatedly to showcase different product lines (beans, soups), each with clear product images and short descriptions.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation.

Scroll-triggered animations are used, including a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image and a large, full-width brand name reveal at the bottom of the page. These effects likely leverage locomotive-scroll for smooth scrolling and gsap for precise animation control.
Product carousels are implemented with horizontal scrolling functionality, likely using a library like swiper, allowing users to browse items without leaving the current section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, blocky, and bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and product details.
design_tokens.radius: Pill-shaped for primary call-to-action buttons, with subtle rounding on some product image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, contributing to a clean and open feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its audacious and playful use of oversized, blocky typography and a high-contrast, energetic color palette, particularly the massive yellow text in the hero and the full-page 'HEYDAY' reveal at the footer. This creates a distinctive, almost pop-art aesthetic that feels fresh and memorable for a food brand.
